relations.note: Stone Boy withstands Iya’s poison, blows, and deception, then defeats him.
Stone Boy flattens Iya’s hands and feet, interrogates him, and later tramples him.
Under duress, Iya reveals how Stone Boy can restore the flattened victims.
Cajete interprets Stone Boy as primordial Iŋyáŋ come to life on earth.

relations.myth: The Stone Boy and the Spider
relations.note: The manuscript title attests a joint narrative, but the interaction and Spider’s identity remain uncertain.
relations.source: Allison, The Stone Boy and the Spider

relations.note: Stone Boy defeats an old Buffalo Woman at ball in an attached cycle.
